Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Snowflake Detail
Snowflake detailing adds a winter themed accent to the design. The pattern can be used alongside simpler decorations to vary the visual texture of a seasonal arrangement while keeping the display within a coordinated festive theme.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Product details
Material: Glass. Colour: Blue. Product measurements: length 30 cm, width 20 cm, height 0.1 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.
Decorative glass baubles featuring a festive Father Christmas motif and delicate snowflake detailing for seasonal charm.
Designed with a hanging format to easily spread ornaments through tree branches or combine them in coordinated displays.
Crafted from durable blue glass, adding colour and visual texture to your Christmas tree arrangement.
Includes one unit of festive tree ornament, perfect for creating a focal point within your holiday decor.

Suitable for Indoor use

6313817046104.sourceDescription:
Product Features:

 Felt velvet wine red pendant, available in various styles: gift box, walking stick, Christmas tree, ice crystal, bow, bell, pinecone, gloves. Each set contains 2 pieces, each approximately 4×5 centimeters in size. It is lightweight and easy to carry.
 Applicable scenarios: Christmas tree, garland, window display, fireplace, holiday party, wedding decoration. The styles are rich, and the entire set can be freely selected and purchased. Compact and exquisite, suitable for decoration and embellishment
 in various occasions.
 Detailed craftsmanship in design, neat silver embroidery pattern, not likely to fall off. The lightweight design will not bend the branches of the Christmas tree, and can effectively enhance the layering and visual effect of the holiday display. 


Product specifications:

 Quantity: 2 pieces
 Color: Red
 Material: Plastic


Package contents:
Christmas decorations * 2 pieces

Note:

 The surface is made of plush fabric. Avoid sharp objects from scratching or rubbing it, and prevent the shedding of fibers and the detachment of embroidery threads.
 Do not wash or soak it. For accumulated dust, use a soft brush to gently clean it; do not place it in a humid environment to prevent mold.
 Handle it gently for storage. Do not apply heavy pressure or stack it, to avoid deformation of the hanging items; store it in a cool and dry place.
Elegant Velvet Christmas Ornaments, 2 pcs per pack. Multiple styles available including candy cane, bell, pine cone, mitten, gift bag and bow, classic burgundy red with delicate silver embroidery, adding vintage festive texture to your Christmas decor.
Made of soft velvet with sturdy inner base, the plush surface is comfortable and premium. Each ornament comes with hanging loop for easy installation, you can hang them on Christmas tree, garland, mantel or window directly.
Exquisite handcrafted details, neat silver embroidered patterns, not easy to fall off. Lightweight design will not bend the branches of Christmas trees, great to enrich layered visual effect of your holiday display.
Versatile holiday decorations, perfect for Christmas tree, fireplace, front door, window, wedding, party and shop window display. Ideal Christmas gift for family, friends and decor lovers.
Reusable Christmas hanging decor. Store in dry and cool place after holiday, these ornaments can be kept well for repeated use in the next Christmas season.

5059059122404.sourceDescription:
Bring classic Christmas warmth into your home with this beautiful set of 25 red mini Christmas baubles. Each pack features a mix of matte, shiny and glitter finishes that create a rich, vibrant look on any tree. Their compact size makes them perfect for filling gaps, adding depth and enhancing both modern and traditional festive themes.

Made from lightweight, shatterproof material, these mini red baubles for Christmas tree are safe for families with children and pets. Unlike glass ornaments, they won’t break or leave sharp fragments, making them ideal for worry free decorating year after year. Each bauble includes a pre attached hanging string, allowing you to decorate your tree, garlands or wreaths in seconds.

Many customers ask, “How many baubles should go on a 7ft tree?” Mini baubles like these are perfect for adding volume alongside larger ornaments. Another common question is “What is a Christmas bauble called?” These classic ornaments are traditionally used to add colour, shine and festive symbolism. When shoppers wonder, “What is the most popular bauble colour?”, red remains one of the top choices for creating a warm and joyful Christmas setting.

These red Christmas baubles aren’t only for trees—they’re also great for crafts, table decorations, window displays and party décor. Pair them with other colours from the Festive Fix collection such as gold, silver, champagne or ice blue to complete your holiday style with ease.
CLASSIC FESTIVE MINI BAUBLES: Set of 25 mini shatterproof ornaments in shiny, matte, and glitter finishes that add timeless sparkle to any Christmas tree.
AVAILABLE IN 5 BEAUTIFUL COLOURS: Choose from Champagne, Gold, Ice Blue, Red, and Silver to match your festive theme or mix for a vibrant look.
SHATTERPROOF & SAFE: Made from durable, lightweight materials — perfect for homes with kids and pets. No more broken glass or sharp fragments.
READY TO HANG: Each bauble comes pre-threaded with a silver string for quick, effortless decorating on trees, garlands, or wreaths.
VERSATILE CHRISTMAS DECOR: Ideal for decorating trees, windows, mantels, and parties — adds festive charm to any home or event.
EXPLORE OUR FESTIVE RANGE: Discover more Christmas decorations, trees, and lights from our brand to complete your holiday collection.
Guarantee - 1 month

7254055206204.sourceDescription:
This beautiful Christmas tree light is meant to create just the right atmosphere for your Christmas. 8 lighting effects: The Christmas decoration has 8 different lighting effects (combination, in wave, sequential, slow glow, chasing/running water, slow fade, twinkle/flash and steady on). 0609484292804.sourceDescription:
Bring a touch of festive charm to your home with this Red Tartan Christmas Tree Skirt, the perfect finishing touch for your seasonal display. Designed with a traditional red tartan pattern, this skirt adds warmth and elegance to your Christmas décor while hiding the legs, trunk or stand of your tree for a neat and polished look. Ideal for both real and artificial trees, the skirt provides a beautiful base that enhances your decorations and creates a cosy, festive atmosphere. The convenient hook and loop fastening makes it quick and easy to put in place, while the design allows it to fold flat for simple storage once the festive season is over. Crafted from quality materials for durability, this tree skirt can be reused year after year, bringing a timeless, classic look to your celebrations. Whether your theme is traditional, rustic or contemporary, this Red Tartan Tree Skirt complements your style and adds a delightful finishing touch to your Christmas tree.
Fun Father Christmas style tree skirt adds a quirky festive touch to your décor.
Conceals the base, trunk or stand of your Christmas tree for a polished look.
Easy to attach and remove with simple hook and loop fastening system.
Folds flat for easy storage, ready to reuse year after year without fuss.
A cheerful finishing touch that completes any Christmas tree display.
For Indoor & outdoor Use

Glitter Finish

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Reusable Design

Create a focal point

SNOW-FLOCKED PINE FOLIAGE: Dense artificial pine-style branches feature a frosted snowy finish, complemented by metallic gold leaves and decorative seasonal accents for a full winter-inspired wreath with attractive texture and depth.
WARM LED FESTIVE ILLUMINATION: Integrated warm LEDs are positioned throughout the foliage to create a soft welcoming glow, highlighting the gold and silver ornaments, white floral details and snow-covered branches during evening displays.
TWO SELECTABLE LIGHTING MODES: Choose between steady illumination for a continuous warm glow or a flashing light effect for a more eye-catching festive appearance, allowing the wreath to complement different Christmas decorating preferences.
55CM BATTERY POWERED WREATH: Measures approximately 55cm across, creating a noticeable seasonal feature for suitable doors, walls and indoor displays. Operates using 3 x AA batteries for flexible cable-free placement. Batteries are not included.

5031470302504.sourceDescription:
Bring a winter-woodland feel to your front door with this Frosted Berry & Pinecone Pre-Lit Christmas Wreath. Available in 45cm and 60cm sizes, it’s beautifully illuminated by LEDs to add a magical festive glow to doors, walls, and other areas of your home.

COLOUR SWITCH & LED LIGHT EFFECTS: Switch from warm white to multi-coloured LEDs to set the perfect festive mood. From gentle fades and twinkles to colour-changing displays, choose from a variety of light effects, with a memory chip remembering your last setting.

FROSTED WITH CONES & BERRIES: Crafted with frosted dual-toned PVC needles, the wreath captures the look of winter woodland foliage for a cosy festive feel. Decorative pinecones and artificial berries create a rich natural finish, while soft tapered tips add texture and depth.

BATTERY POWERED WITH TIMER: Powered by an IP44-rated battery pack, the wreath can be displayed indoors or outdoors without worrying about plugging it in. A built-in timer conveniently switches the LEDs on at the same time every evening, then turns them off six hours later.

METAL FRAME FOR EASY HANGING: A durable circular metal frame makes the wreath easy to hang on front doors, walls, windows, or above your mantelpiece. Coloured dark green, it blends discreetly with the frosted foliage to create a neater, more attractive display when hanging.

Specifications
Available Sizes: 45cm / 60cm
LED Count: 40 (45cm) / 50 (60cm)
Colour Switch LEDs: Warm white and multi-colour
Timer Function: 6 hours on / 18 hours off
Snow frosted pre-lit wreath with pinecones and berries
Warm white & multi-colour LEDs with built-in colour switch
IP44-rated battery pack with timer for easy festive lighting
105 / 140 tapered PVC tips for a full natural look
Metal frame for easy hanging on front doors and windows

5313817006604.sourceDescription:
Product Overview

 This festive pink Christmas tinsel garland comes pre-assembled with warm white clear wire LED lights and cute Santa & snowflake cutout decorations. 
 Powered by 3 AA batteries (batteries NOT included), it has two size options and supports steady-on & flashing lighting modes.

Specifications
Option 1: 3 m / 9.8 ft 30 Warm white LEDs 3AA battery box Steady on + FlashOption 2: 5.7 m / 18.7 ft 40 Warm white LEDs 3AA battery box Steady on + Flash

 Material: Soft pink PET tinsel, transparent wire with warm white LED, paper Santa & snowflake pendants
 Light color: Warm white (3000K)
 Power source: 3 × AA batteries (batteries excluded)
 Modes: Constant steady light & flashing twinkle, switch controlled by battery box
 Protection grade: IP44 (splash-proof, for indoor & covered outdoor use)
 Lifespan: 20000 hours

Application Scenarios
Christmas home decor, Xmas tree, front door arch, staircase railing, fireplace mantel, window frame, bedroom headboard, holiday party decoration, covered patio.
Notes

 Batteries are not included, please prepare 3 AA batteries before use.
 IP44 splash-proof: resistant to splashing water, do NOT submerge in water.
 Remove batteries when not in use for a long time to avoid battery leakage damage.
【Pink Christmas-Themed Design】Unlike traditional red and green Christmas lights, this string of lights features a fresh pink color scheme, paired with classic Santa Claus figures and whimsical snowflake accents for a soft and sweet style. Perfect as festive decor for your daughter’s bedroom, drape it over the windowsill or bed rail—the adorable color scheme will be a big hit with little ones, creating a sweet little Christmas nook.
【Total Length: 9.8 Feet & 30 LED Bulbs】This pink string light measures 9.8 feet in total length and features 30 evenly spaced LED bulbs, creating a perfectly balanced distribution of light. Whether draped around a Christmas tree, doorframe, or railing, a single strand of these pink lights can complete the decoration for a small area. There’s no need to connect multiple strands, resulting in a neater, more aesthetically pleasing look. The staggered lighting creates a more immersive Christmas atmosphere.
【2 Lighting Modes】This Christmas string light features two practical lighting modes—steady and flashing—with simple, intuitive operation. For a family Christmas Eve dinner or post-meal relaxation, turn on the steady, soft glow to create a quiet and soothing atmosphere; when friends and family gather or for a children’s Christmas party, switch to the flashing dynamic light effect to highlight the lively and joyful festive spirit. One string of lights meets a variety of mood needs.
【Battery-Powered】This pink garland is battery-powered, eliminating the need for electrical outlets or the hassle of long extension cords. Installation requires no special tools—simply wrap it around branches, door frames, railings, or window frames to secure it. Even beginners can set it up in just a few minutes. Taking it down and storing it after the holidays is just as easy; it folds flat to save space and can be reused next Christmas.
【Christmas-Themed Lighting】This Christmas tinsel garland is designed specifically for the holiday season. It can be wrapped around Christmas trees, front door frames, window frames, balcony railings, and stair handrails. It’s also perfect as a backdrop for Christmas parties, bedroom decor, and festive window displays—making it an excellent choice for creating that special Christmas atmosphere.
Guarantee - 1 month

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture

5056214070204.sourceDescription:
Feel the sparkle without the flame. Introducing this set of six light packed Fire work Tea Lights. Each piece features 20 warm-white micro LEDs that softly twinkle like miniature fire works, creating an atmospheric glow ideal for dinners, mantel displays, or cosy autumn evenings.

These lights are battery operated and housed in sleek silver plastic bases, delivering a safe, clean and wire-free way to light up your home. They're compact and lightweight, making them easy to sprinkle across a table centrepiece, group them around houseplants, or position them by a bedside lamp. 

And they're reusable too! The energy-efficient micro LEDs give hours of sparkle, and when they eventually need new batteries, they're ready to shine again next season. They're also a great gift, everyone loves a bit of sparkle without the fuss.

Supplied as a set of six Fire work Tea Lights.
SPARKLING AMBIENCE: Six fire work tea lights, each with 20 warm-white micro LEDs that emit a gentle, flickering glow. Perfect for creating a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere during meals or quiet evenings.
SAFE AND FUSS FREE: Battery powered with no flame, no heat and no wiring. Just insert batteries and switch on for beautiful sparkle that's ideal for homes with children or pets.
VERSATILE DECOR: Compact silver-based design lets you group them on tables, bookshelves or candle trays, or use individually to accent corners or highlight plants and seasonal displays.
DETAILS: Supplied as a pack of six warm-white fire work effect micro LED tea lights in silver bases. Indoor use only. Simply wipe clean, insert batteries, switch on, and enjoy.
ABOUT US: At YouGarden, we believe that gardening is for everyone. Based in rural Lincolnshire we have our own 11 acre nursery, meaning that we are in close contact with our plants, so that we can guarantee our plants will thrive because we've grown them ourselves. We also source product locally, nationally and internationally to ensure we give our customers the best range, highest quality and greatest value for money. All our products will arrive in nursery fresh condition.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show

A flexible finishing touch

Plan the display

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.
